title: coelogyne tetradactylifera
intro: Coelogyne tetradactylifera, commonly known as the Four-fingered Orchid, is a species of orchid native to the tropical forests of Southeast Asia. This plant is known for its unique, four-fingered petals that distinguish it from other orchid species. Research has shown that Coelogyne tetradactylifera contains bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been found to possess therapeutic actions including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits associated with Coelogyne tetradactylifera include its potential to help manage stress, improve cognitive function, and support immune system health due to its bioactive constituents.
